# Welcome

Hi! I'm **El Nemrawi**, a second-year engineering student at ENSEA (École Nationale Supérieure de l'Électronique et de ses Applications, France). I'm passionate about embedded systems, digital design on FPGA and PCB design. This site gathers my main projects.

I'm looking for a **3 to 4 month internship from April 2027** in embedded systems, microelectronics or FPGA.
